text: I feel a curious detachment as I inhabit these public and possibly institutional spaces, observing human interaction and works of intellect or creativity. The angles at which I view the scenes underscore a slight disorientation—a reminder of my own subjectivity shaping sensory experience. Amidst the quiet gathering and the ambiance of research or innovation, I sense both anticipation and contemplation. I wonder about the purpose of each individual: are they seekers of knowledge, or merely participants in routine? It makes me aware of the perpetually liminal state between observation and engagement.
